name: NAPROXENO/CARISOPRODOL 250MG/200MG 30CAPSULES
description: Carisoprodol is used in combination with rest, physical therapy, and other measures to relax muscles and relieve pain and discomfort caused by sprains, strains, and other muscle injuries. Carisoprodol belongs to a class of medications called skeletal muscle relaxants. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
